title: Obico Failure Detection Confidence Percent Leaderboard
dataSources: Print jobs (`octoprint:job`), printer firmware telemetry (`printer:telemetry`), filament spools (`filament:spool`), CNC/laser jobs (`cnc:job`), workshop air (`workshop:air`), cordless tool batteries (`tool:battery`).
app: OctoPrint / Klipper (Moonraker) print servers, printer firmware telemetry, filament spool tracking, CNC/laser job logs, and workshop air/tool sensors via HEC and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=obico:detection confidence_pct=*
| stats sum(confidence_pct) as total_value, avg(confidence_pct) as avg_value by printer_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks printer values by total and average confidence percent across Obico failure detection events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `confidence_pct` values for each Obico failure detection event and review total and average confidence percent by printer.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total confidence percent.
grandmaExplanation: It times which printer shows the biggest confidence percent numbers in your Obico failure detection data.
